jobs.occupation: Change Manager – IS Transformation & Cyber Security
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Nice to Haves

• Experience implementing Security by Design principles within project lifecycles.
• Familiarity with the CyFun Essential framework.

You will work in Ninove, in a modern and highly automated environment specialized in logistics automation and automated warehouse systems.

The company develops, integrates and maintains automation solutions that help warehouses, production environments and distribution centers operate more efficiently.

Jobomschrijving

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.

Your responsibilities:
	
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.	
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.	
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.	
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.

• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.	
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations.

	
• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.	
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.	
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.	
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.	
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.	
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.	
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.	
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.	
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.	
• Good physical fitness.	
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.	
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.
They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.

Your key responsibilities:
	
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.	
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.	
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.	
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.	
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:
	
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.	
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 	
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.	
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.	
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.	
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.	
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Our client is an international maritime organization based in Essen.

Jobomschrijving

Unique Antwerp Maritime is looking for a Crew Planner.
You will be working for one of our clients, one of the largest offshore pipeline installation and subsea construction companies, located in Essen.

In this role, you will take full responsibility for crew planning within your assigned disciplines. You ensure everything runs smoothly — from long-term workforce planning to last-minute solutions.

Your responsibilities include:
	
• Creating and managing crew schedules for personnel on board our vessels	
• Acting as the point of contact for superintendents, captains, and shore-based colleagues	
• Collaborating closely with HR, Operations, and the crew members themselves	
• Taking into account experience, certifications, and project requirements	
• Identifying shortages or surpluses in staffing and contributing to solutions	
• Ensuring a fair distribution of experience and opportunities within teams	
• Discussing career growth and development opportunities for crew members together with HR
In short: you maintain oversight in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same.

What matters to us?
Your curiosity, drive, and enjoyment of what you do. It’s a big plus if you also bring:
	
• At least 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar role, such as crew planning or transport planning	
• The ability to stay calm and maintain an overview, even when everything happens at once	
• Clear and friendly communication skills, with a good sense of humor	
• The confidence to make decisions and take responsibility, always with respect and situational awareness	
• Fluency in spoken and written English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus	
• A willingness to travel occasionally, for example to vessels or our office in Delft

jobs.occupation: Tax specialist - Brussels - International Retail Company
jobs.description:
Our client is an international player and global leader in the retail sector with a strong branding and unique company culture. They are currently expanding and reorganizing their finance team to adapt their strategy to the current market.

Jobomschrijving

As a Tax Specialist your function will be twofold. On one side reporting to the accounting manager for the Belgian HQ as well as to the CFO of the e-commerce marketplace.

Belgian HQ:

• Manage monthly VAT filings (BE, FR & LUX)
• Intrastat and statistical declarations (BE, FR & LUX)
• Managing intercompany netting processes and related tax implications.
• Ensuring compliance with indirect tax, customs, and cross-border transaction requirement
• Ensure accurate corporate tax provisions (ISOC)
• Oversee quarterly VAT calculations
• Management Report (PM)
• Corporate tax calculation, transfer pricing and client listings
• Support Pillar 2 compliance 

E-commerce Marketplace:

• Support tax projects and implement tax controls.
• Ensure compliance with DAC7, Deemed Supplier, and C2C requirements.
• Review and validate invoice flows.
• Support profit split analyses and related tax matters.
• Act as the main tax contact for the marketplace business.
• Coordinate with local tax specialists on international projects.
• Identify tax risks and support process improvements.

The ideal candidate matches the following criteria:

• Master's degree in Finance or Law, specialized in Tax / Fiscal sciences
• Fluent in English and good command of French or Dutch
• Strong expertise in corporate tax and indirect tax (VAT)
• Hands-on with proven ability to execute operational tax tasks
• Critical mindset, ability to analyse future impact of regulations on the business
• Experience in international and cross-border tax environments
• Ability to manage multiple compliance cycles (monthly, quarterly, annual)
• Strong communication skills for stakeholder and cross-country coordination

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in Charleroi - Industry sector
Project Finance in Charleroi - Industry sector

jobs.description:
Our client is an energy company.

Jobomschrijving

You will work closely with cross-functional teams including development, engineering, finance, tax, legal and operations, and senior management, while collaborating with external advisors, lenders, investors and counterparties to deliver strategic projects and transactions.

• Buy-side M&A transaction: Together with the Director, leading financial appraisal, due diligence, and structuring of BESS and PV transactions.
• Modelling: Build and stress-test investment models (revenue, degradation, volatility, constraints) and translate outputs into clear investment recommendations and strategic decision making to the Director.
• Negotiation: Together with Senior Legal evaluate, negotiate, and optimize key project contracts (PPA, tolling, EPC, O&M/LTSA) through a risk-return lens to protect capital and increase value.
• Project Financing: Ensure projects meet international project finance bankability requirements and optimize cost of capital through robust structuring - in charge of document negotiation with equity and debt providers.
• Strategy: Contribute to portfolio strategy by assessing future risks and opportunities (e.g., grid connection models, longer duration assets, alternative technologies, new jurisdictions).
• Monitoring: Monitor execution and early operational performance, validating investment assumptions and driving feedback loops into future decisions (ie. monitoring actual portfolio performance against budgets and forecasts, preparing performance reports including key financial and business metrics).
• Invoices & Budget: Oversees (and be responsible for) cost control, invoice tracking, annual budgeting and financial reporting.

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related field.
• 7-10 years of experience in investment banking, other forms of M&A advisory, project finance, valuation, ideally with exposure and/or strong interest for renewable energy and energy transition
• Strong financial modelling skills and an understanding of project and corporate finance
• Excellent analytical and presentation skills
• Ability to manage work under pressure in a collaborative environment
• Commercial, outward looking, and focusing on adding value
• Strong critical thinking and willingness to challenge assumptions constructively across the team (technical, development, commercial)
• Excellent communication, organisational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships across internal and external stakeholders
• Fluency in English. French or Dutch is a plus.
